I stepped outside IN THE DARK and “cuss-screamed” at them to STFU!!!!.

Sometimes I would be on a conference call from home and the screaming kids made it sound as though I was calling from a bar or club.
I finally stopped by to explain the challenge.
The kids fetched “daddy”.
I told him that his screaming kids were now famous.
He apologized, and quieted the kids.
The adults frequently stand outside screaming loudly into cell phones in a language that sounds vicious and angry.
They are prone to doing construction on the weekends, and at all hours.
Once, I thought I heard a jackhammer!
I couldn’t tell whether they were digging a basement beneath the foundation, or a tunnel back to their country of origin.
I have called the police on several occasions.
The solution: I delivered a letter, with my contact INFORMATION.
One of the younger men in the household responded via email.
We continue to stay in contact.
